shots.description: The camera tracks backward at the same steady pace, height and medium framing as <Video 1>, holding the running group centered on the daisy slope. In the left foreground, <Subject 5> runs toward the lens smiling and exits the left edge of frame at about the two-second mark exactly as in <Video 1>, softening slightly in the near focus before leaving. Just to their right, <Subject 1> runs forward in the position they hold in <Video 1>; the original khaki-brown jacket is gone and the child now wears <Subject 3> - the washed denim sits open at the sherpa collar, the metal buttons catch the low sun, and the "WILD CHILD" embroidery and patch graphics are legible on the chest as the fabric folds and swings with each stride - while <Subject 1>'s face, shoulder-length brown hair and body remain as in the source. In the center, <Subject 4> leads the group in the off-white button-down shirt with long hair streaming sideways. At the right rear, at the same position and on-screen scale as the rearmost child in <Video 1>, that child and the brown jacket and khaki top they wore no longer appear; <Subject 2> runs there instead, on all fours and at the group's pace, the golden coat rippling in the backlight, the long droopy ears bouncing with each stride, the dark nose pointing at the lens and the mouth open with the pink tongue out, fully visible at the rear of the formation. From the two-second mark to the end, the three remaining figures - <Subject 1> now leftmost, <Subject 4> in the center and <Subject 2> at the right rear - continue running toward the tracking camera, hair, denim and fur moving with the same easy rhythm as <Video 1>, and the shot closes on this formation with no new action, cut or camera change. Synchronized sound: rapid footfalls through the grass and the dog's panting rise with the run.
